title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base For Countertop Kitchen Decor | Allied Brass
description:
Keep a roll ready on your kitchen counter with this freestanding paper towel holder. Solid brass construction and a weighted base help it stay steady during tear-off, while a felt pad helps protect your countertop from scratches.

Highlights:
- Freestanding countertop paper towel holder (no wall mounting required)
- Solid brass with a weighted base to help prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Coordinates with modern kitchen decor and contemporary accessories
- Available in a wide variety of designer finishes

Specs:
- Category: Paper Towel Holders
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Keyword note: Ideal for shoppers looking for freestanding holders, countertop paper towel stands, modern bathroom hardware styling adapted for kitchen spaces, and contemporary bath accessories looks used in mixed-material home decor.
